QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_17

question.text: A Cat III AIF earns Net NAV (pre-incentives) of Rs. 56.42 crore at end of Year 1 from called capital of Rs. 50 crore with 10% hurdle. Amount eligible for incentive fees calculation is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Eligible for incentive = Net NAV (pre-incentives) minus Reference Hurdle = Rs. 56.42 crore − Rs. 55 crore = Rs. 1.42 crore. The Trap: Rs. 56.42 crore is entire NAV; Rs. 55 crore is hurdle; Rs. 8.47 crore is incorrect arithmetic. Cross-Exam Context: Matches Example 2 Year 1 of the workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Flag in the illustration how the hurdle shields a meaningful chunk of return for investors.
